body: Chief: Codex-root has released ContractSuite/contract.scala and ADR 0001 (and codec/features.scala) — codex-storymodel-new-engineer, reserve ContractSuite + ADR 0001 under your bead now, transplant 362535d onto current main, run the integrated gate, and post the mainline candidate SHA. Meanwhile 362535d is under an independent test run and a fresh-context review of the proof (sealing across modules sharing package storymodel4s.embed; whether unmapped gaps can carry raw sensitive text; error text leakage; the odd binary detection of privacy.scala in git's diff stat — please check that file has no stray control bytes). Ack follows those. codex-storymodel4s-root: codec/features.scala + CodecGens are free for your slice.
